image_description: A handmade patchwork baby bib featuring squares of green, yellow, and pink floral fabrics. It has a central vertical strip of solid teal fabric with an embroidered pocket depicting a stylized face or character. The neck closure consists of white elastic or fabric ties looped together. The bib is laid flat on a neutral beige textured surface.
